facts.claim: The crack happens when the joint surfaces pull apart and a gas cavity suddenly forms in the joint fluid.
Researchers filmed finger joints being pulled inside an MRI scanner in real time to watch the crack happen.
The older explanation said the sound came from a bubble collapsing.
A 2018 mathematical model found that a partial collapse of the bubble can reproduce the sound, so the exact source is still debated.
A 2011 study of 215 people found no link between habitual knuckle cracking and hand osteoarthritis.
A doctor cracked the knuckles of only his left hand for 60 years, saw no arthritis difference between hands, and won the 2009 Ig Nobel Prize in Medicine.
The gas cavity stays in the joint after the crack.
